threshold.rule: flag as malicious if P(malicious) >= threshold
threshold.how_chosen: minimises C_FN*FN + C_FP*FP over every distinct score on TRAIN out-of-fold predictions (persisted 3-fold CV of the train split, data/splits/cv_fold_ids; tuned params, fixed 609 rounds as the refit); cut placed midway to the next lower score. No test set was used.
threshold.caveat: classes are 50/50 by construction; re-derive the threshold for a deployment with another prevalence

training_data.dataset: EMBER2024 (thrember), Win64 PE files, weekly releases
training_data.description: trained on the 'train' split: files from weeks 0-51, deduplicated by sha256, stratified by label x week, classes about 50/50 by construction. test_random is held out from the same weeks; test_future is weeks 52-63, strictly later.

demo_samples.how: 300 label x week stratified test_future rows plus up to 50 false positives and 50 false negatives at the threshold (seed 42); 'position' is the row index inside test_future
